plans.buy_case: AKAM is firing a textbook mean-reversion setup: RSI 38.6 in oversold territory, price squeezed near lower Bollinger Band, and strong technical structure (50MA > 200MA, price above 200MA). Volume confirmation and neutral VIX provide a low-friction entry environment for a swing trade.
plans.entry_condition: Wait for RSI to dip to 30-32 range OR price to touch lower Bollinger Band (~$122.50). Do not chase at current levels—let mean reversion come to you. This is a quality company; patience will give you better risk/reward.
plans.exit_condition: Take profits at RSI 70+ (overbought) or if price breaks above 50MA convincingly (~$128+). Hard stop: close position if price closes below 200MA ($99.08) on high volume—signals broken structure.
plans.risk: Fundamental news vacuum is a real problem. You're trading technicals blind on earnings/guidance. A surprise earnings miss could gap below support. Also: $3,097 portfolio means 1 share has low capital efficiency; consider if this is the best use of dry powder.
plans.note_to_student: Don't buy today. Set alerts for $122.50 and RSI 30. This setup improves on a retest. Busy schedule means you need high-probability entries, not FOMO entries. The BB squeeze will resolve soon—make sure you're on the right side of it.

Also, the 'lack of recent news' flag is concerning—you need current occupancy/rent growth data before committing. If AVB misses on occupancy trends, this bounces right back down.

plans.buy_case: EW is showing classic mean-reversion setup: Bollinger Band squeeze + MACD turning up + bullish RSI divergence (price lower low but RSI higher low = weakening downside momentum). Price is anchored above 200MA with golden cross in place—technical structure is sound. However, RSI at 56 is already warm, not in the juicy 20-30 buy zone, so entry timing is critical.
plans.entry_condition: Wait for pullback to lower Bollinger Band (~$84.50–$85.50) OR RSI dip to 35–40 range before buying. Do NOT chase at current price. A squeeze breakout without a proper pullback entry sacrifices your risk/reward ratio.
plans.exit_condition: Sell into strength at upper BB (~$90–$91.50) OR if RSI breaks above 70 and starts rolling over (exit the pop). Hard stop: break below 200MA ($81.96) or if MACD histogram rolls negative again—exit immediately.
plans.risk: RSI already elevated (56) means momentum may be fading. If the squeeze breaks downward instead of up, you're caught in the wrong trade. Also: healthcare is rate-sensitive; any hawkish Fed pivot could pressure EW. Missing news/earnings data is a blind spot.
plans.additional_note: This is a **conditional buy**, not a market-order buy. Your $175 position size (2 shares) is appropriately sized for a $3K portfolio. Be patient—the setup is good but the entry price matters. If you can't get it at $85–$86, pass and wait for the next opportunity. Do not FOMO chase at $87+
